P01: Seeks to locate all teaching rooms no more than one flight above grade and near the assembly space, establish a recognizable public identity, and place administrative oversight, health services and specialized learning assistance together.
P02: Intends to establish a prominent cultural gathering place for residents by arranging creative and theatrical facilities alongside shared spaces, while connecting all three volumes internally to minimize everyday travel distances and exposure to weather.
P03: Seeks to establish a readily understood principal entrance shared by guests, caregivers and pupils during regular circulation, position teaching spaces at the quieter extremity of the connected buildings, and provide public access to communal facilities.
P04: Intends to accommodate the majority of pupils and employees within one structure with limited travel between levels, while allocating separate street-level accommodation for disruptive creative activities and maintenance functions adjoining the assembly space and food preparation area.
P05: Seeks to arrange each of the three building volumes across three storeys, provide enclosed connections allowing travel between every pair, and combine creative facilities with the assembly space for performances and gatherings involving local residents.
P06: Intends to encourage regular interaction between pupils from the two classroom sections through shared central routes leading to meals, group gatherings and creative activities, while establishing a common place for the wider public to gather.
P07: Aims to use meals, whole-school gatherings and physical education as recurring opportunities for interaction across the school population, while organizing academic accommodation as an independently functioning instructional structure with creative facilities adjacent to teaching rooms.
P08: Seeks to enable public activities in the communal building outside teaching hours without granting access to other school areas, while accommodating pupils' everyday requirements, including healthcare provision, within the academic building.
P09: Intends to accommodate administrative decision-makers and book collections within the principal teaching structure, while establishing separate accommodation for pupils requiring additional educational assistance, positioned near healthcare facilities and practical creative workspaces.
P10: Aims to permit separate public access to the assembly facility, centralize access protection within the connected linear buildings, and locate the book collection on the highest level of the structure accommodating most pupils' teaching activities.
P11: Seeks to establish one monitored access point through which personnel can regulate entry to teaching areas and the assembly facility, while providing nighttime public access to gatherings and creative activities without passage through instructional circulation routes.
P12: Intends to establish a centrally located, monitored reception for guests, separate teaching accommodation acoustically from assembly activities, and position creative and book-related facilities alongside the gathering space to support public participation.
P13: Aims to position shared gathering facilities as the primary setting for school interaction and public arrival, while separating the instructional section and its creative workrooms from circulation associated with outside guests.
P14: Seeks to enable public access to the assembly space and practical workroom, allow their construction in separate stages, and maintain controlled teaching operations within one continuous, internally connected building section.
P15: Intends to create a sheltered exterior gathering space accessible from all three school volumes, arrange enclosed movement routes around its perimeter, and locate facilities for books and reading at the main gathering area above communal eating accommodation.
